    • 字段详细资料

      • batchId

        @NameInMap(value="BatchId")
public String batchId

        The batch ID. This is the batch ID returned when callee data is imported. You can view the batch ID on the Call task management > Details > Execution records page, or use the batch ID returned when you call the ImportTaskNumberDatas operation to import callee data. If the DetailIdList parameter is specified, this parameter is invalid.

        example:

        4253331213*****

      • detailIdList

        @NameInMap(value="DetailIdList")
public List<String> detailIdList

        The list of task detail IDs. If this parameter is specified, it takes precedence, and the BatchId and PhoneNumbers parameters are invalid.

      • encryptionType

        @NameInMap(value="EncryptionType")
public Long encryptionType

        The encryption method. Valid values:

        • 0: No encryption.
        • 1: MD5.
        • 2: SHA256.
        • 3: SM3.
        example:

        0

      • taskId

        @NameInMap(value="TaskId")
public String taskId

        The task ID. You can view the task ID on the Call task management page or obtain the task ID by calling the QueryAiCallTaskPage operation.

        This parameter is required.

        example:
